description: This file defines the NotInBinary class in the Twig templating engine, representing the 'not in' binary operator node in an expression syntax tree.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\NotInBinary
classes.description: Represents a 'not in' binary operation node within Twig's expression parser, enabling the compilation of 'not in' expressions in templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the 'not in' binary expression into PHP code by calling the inFilter method and negating its result.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the operator, 'not in'.
